test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statement.

**Statements:**

Few melons are bananas

No banana is a cherry

All cherries are litchis

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some litchis are not bananas

(II) All bananas are melons

(III) All litchis are cherries

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follows

solution:
Statements:

Few melons are bananas.

No banana is a cherry.

All cherries are litchis.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd0d17cbfb4a9cc274734661aefb0fee6112c3cd04cbad99eccea9b67b8f5259.png] 

**Conclusions: **

(I) Some litchis are not bananas → **True **(Some litchis are cherries, and no banana is a cherry. Thus, some litchis are not bananas is definitely true).

(II) All bananas are melons → False (As Few melons are bananas,All bananas are melons is possible but not definitely true).

(III) All litchis are cherries → False (All cherries are litchis , So All litchis are cherries is possible but not definitely true).

Hence,** 'Only conclusion I follows'.**
